Auth.title: Secure account and organization access
Auth.description: FastAPI validates login, session rotation, roles, and organization scope. Long-lived credentials are never stored in browser storage.
Auth.cookieBody: Access and refresh credentials stay in cookies that browser JavaScript cannot read.
Auth.tenantBody: Owner, staff, and customer permissions are enforced per organization by the API.
Auth.loginHint: Use a demo identity or a customer account you registered.
Auth.registerHint: Public registration joins an existing organization with the customer role.
Auth.demoBody: Owner, staff, and customer accounts use ServiceOps-Demo-2026! as the password.
Auth.registerSuccess: Your customer account was created and signed in.
